title: Beyond Sparse Rewards: A New Benchmark and Structure-Aware Graph Alignment for Micro-Drama Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.07107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Micro-dramas, characterized by ultra-short durations and hyper-dense storylines, pose unique challenges for video understanding that conventional benchmarks fail to address. To bridge this gap, we introduce M-Drama, the first large-scale bilingual benchmark for micro-drama comprehension, featuring over 35K instances across 9,138 clips. Furthermore, while reinforcement learning can enhance VLMs on complex narratives, existing reward metrics often suffer from sparse and superficial signals, failing to capture intricate character identities and temporal structures. We propose SAGA (Structure-Aware Graph Alignment), a novel graph-matching reward function that models narratives as heterogeneous graphs. SAGA computes dense, rigorous rewards via decoupled semantic triplet and structural temporal matching. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct demonstrate that SAGA outperforms existing baselines, delivering substantial improvements in op

translated_title: 超越稀疏奖励：面向微短剧理解的新基准与结构感知图对齐方法
translated_abstract: 微短剧以其超短的时长和高度密集的故事情节，为视频理解带来了独特的挑战，而传统基准测试无法解决这些问题。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了M-Drama，这是首个面向微短剧理解的大规模双语基准，涵盖9,138个视频片段中的超过35,000个实例。此外，尽管强化学习可以增强视觉语言模型（VLM）处理复杂叙事的能力，但现有的奖励度量往往存在奖励信号稀疏且浅层的问题，无法捕捉复杂的人物身份和时间结构。我们提出了SAGA（结构感知图对齐），这是一种新颖的图匹配奖励函数，将叙事建模为异构图。SAGA通过解耦的语义三元组匹配和结构化时间匹配，计算出密集且严格的奖励。在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型上的大量实验表明，SAGA优于现有基线方法，带来了显著的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出了首个微短剧理解大规模双语基准M-Drama，并设计了结构感知图对齐奖励函数SAGA，通过将叙事建模为异构图并进行解耦的语义三元组与结构化时间匹配，解决了强化学习中奖励信号稀疏且浅层的问题，显著提升了视觉语言模型对微短剧的理解能力。
